why: Pensoft taxonomic paper: six genus and species treatments are <sec sec-type="taxon-treatment"> holding treatment-* subsections (type species or type materials, diagnosis, description, etymology, distribution, and others), plus a dichotomous identification key set as an unlabelled <table-wrap> and one XML-treatment <supplementary-material> per taxon. Pins the treatment hierarchy at its source depth, the key's rows, the ZooBank URLs kept, the invisible U+FEFF treatment labels dropped, and the Additional information subsections. Genus and species <named-content>s set with nothing between them read as two words, in the body and in reference titles alike, and each treatment's <sec-meta> taxon classification as one labeled line. Its mixed citations set <name>s with nothing between them; they read comma-separated.
